summary: Joseph hid his silver cup in Benjamin's sack to test his brothers. When Benjamin was about to be taken as a slave, Judah offered to take his place.

story_reel.narration: Joseph had one more test for his brothers. He told his servant, 'Fill their sacks with grain, and put my silver cup in the youngest one's sack.' The next morning, the brothers set off for home. But soon Joseph's servant chased after them. 'Why have you stolen my master's silver cup?' The brothers were shocked. 'We would never do that! If you find it with any of us, that one can die, and the rest of us will be slaves!' The servant searched each sack, from the oldest to the youngest. And there it was, in Benjamin's sack! The brothers tore their clothes in grief and went back to Joseph. Joseph said, 'The one who had the cup will be my slave. The rest of you can go home.' Years before, the brothers had sold Joseph and gone home without him. Would they abandon Benjamin too? Then Judah stepped forward. 'Please, my lord, let me stay as your slave instead of the boy. If I go home without him, it will break my father's heart.' Judah was willing to give up his own freedom for his brother. The brothers had truly changed.

scenes.caption: A secret plan
scenes.art_direction: Joseph whispering to his steward, holding up a shining silver cup.

scenes.caption: The chase
scenes.art_direction: The steward galloping after the brothers' donkey caravan.

scenes.caption: Search the sacks!
scenes.art_direction: Grain sacks opened one by one, oldest to youngest; suspense music.

scenes.caption: In Benjamin's sack!
scenes.art_direction: The silver cup gleaming in Benjamin's sack; brothers gasping.

scenes.caption: Back before Joseph
scenes.art_direction: The brothers kneeling, faces to the ground, Benjamin trembling.

scenes.caption: 'Let me stay instead'
scenes.art_direction: Judah stepping forward, hand on Benjamin's shoulder, brave and humble.

memory_verse.text: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

identity_focus.core_truth: I can show great love by putting others before myself.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: Judah offered to take Benjamin's place. Jesus did the same for us! How can you put someone else first this week?
reflection_choices: Give up something I want for someone else

quiz.question: Where did Joseph's servant put the silver cup?
quiz.explanation: Joseph told his steward to put the silver cup in the sack of the youngest.

quiz.question: Who offered to stay as a slave instead of Benjamin?
quiz.explanation: Judah said, 'Please let your servant stay instead of the boy, a bondservant to my lord.'

quiz.question: Why did Judah not want to go home without Benjamin?
options: He was afraid of the desert
He wanted to live in Egypt
It would break his father's heart
quiz.explanation: Judah said that if the boy wasn't with them, their father would die of grief.

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, thank You that Jesus gave His life for me. Help me love others like that, putting them first and standing up for them. Amen.

companion.message: When Judah offered to take Benjamin's place, I knew my brothers' hearts were different. I couldn't keep my secret any longer...
